snapshot.name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd
snapshot.about: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited, incorporated in 1993 , is a Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) company with operations in the electronic products vertical such as consumer electronics, lighting, home appliance, closed-circuit television cameras (CCTVs), and mobile phones. It also undertakes reverse logistics operations. Besides, it manufactures security surveillance equipment, wearables & audibles, AC-PCBs. Recently, it has entered a JV with Imagine Marketing Private Limited for designing and manufacturing wireless audio solutions in India. [1]

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Management continues to guide for massive capacity expansions and multi-thousand crore revenues across segments like display and IT hardware.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Quarterly sales fluctuate significantly (e.g., INR 10,672 crore in Dec 2025 to INR 21,794 crore in Sep 2026), reflecting seasonality and large project timelines.

promises.credibility: Management is aggressive in outlining multi-year capacity and revenue targets, but many horizons are pending or require longer-term tracking against volatile quarterly execution.

bull: Growth is accelerating significantly, with revenue CAGR rising from 50% over 5y to 59% over 3y.
Profit is outgrowing revenue, demonstrated by a 3-year PAT CAGR of 86% compared to 59% for revenue.
The balance sheet is strong as investments of ₹1,389 Cr exceed borrowings of ₹1,236 Cr with a Debt/Equity of 0.21.
bear: Latest quarter Sep 2026 saw PAT decline -45% YoY with a margin of 2.7% down -1.0pp YoY.
Mar 2022 revenue jumped 66% as a step change, meaning CAGRs straddling it overstate organic growth.
Capex is currently in progress with CWIP at 21% of fixed assets representing growth capacity not yet earning.
